# Postloom

> Postloom is a set of free online tools for social media visuals: a tweet card generator, a carousel maker and a testimonial generator. It turns a tweet (pasted by URL or written from scratch) into a polished image or animated GIF for sharing on Instagram, LinkedIn, X/Twitter and Threads. No sign-up, no watermark, unlimited downloads.

## What you can do

- Import a tweet by URL, or write the text, name, handle and metrics yourself
- Choose a card style for X/Twitter, Threads or LinkedIn, plus light, dim or dark themes
- Customise background (solid, gradient, image), padding, canvas size and brand kit
- Build threads, polls, quote tweets and replies
- Export as PNG or animated GIF in sizes for Instagram posts and stories, LinkedIn and X

## Links

- [Home](https://postloom.studio/): overview and FAQ
- [Tweet Card Generator](https://postloom.studio/tweet-card-generator): the free editor, runs in the browser
- [Carousel Maker](https://postloom.studio/carousel-maker): turn a tweet thread or any text into 1080x1350 Instagram carousel slides (PNG) or a LinkedIn PDF carousel; free, no sign-up
- [Testimonial Generator](https://postloom.studio/testimonial-generator): turn tweets (pasted by link) and customer quotes into branded testimonial images (PNG, square, portrait or landscape) and copy a free "wall of love" HTML embed for your website; free, no sign-up, no watermark
